title: Braised Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A hearty, aromatic stew originating from North Africa, characterized by a rich flavor and tender lamb.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of kissed in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, then set aside.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the Algerian, salt, and black pepper; stir to combine.
Add the browned lamb, water, and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer to the oven; braise for 2.5 hours at 300°F.
Check the lamb for tenderness and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
